title: You can get it if you really want - Desmond Dekker

lines.l: You can get it if you really want, but you must try, try and try, try and try, you'll succeed at last.
Persecution, you must fear. Win or lose, you gotta get your sheep. You've got your mind set on a tree.
You can get it if you really want

You must try, try and try, try and try
You'll succeed at last
Don't you know me
Listen, Rome was not built in a day

But they utter, they battle you see
